Citta · Beginner guide

A personal learning space for reading, listening, reflecting and connecting ideas over time.

Who can use it

Students, researchers and anyone who wants to return to ideas from long readings.

How to get it

Citta is in active development for Android and Windows. Public installation instructions will accompany an approved release.

Your first session

For a first session, choose a short text and one idea you want to remember. Try the reading and reflection workflow once a public build is available.

What you can do

  • Focused reading and text-to-speech go together. Follow spoken words on screen where highlighting is supported.
  • Keep a personal library. Save notes and highlights that point back to their source.
  • Arrange ideas visually, connect them in a mind map and revisit them at spaced intervals.

Data and backups

Citta is designed around on-device storage. Keep the original documents independently. Follow the instructions for your release once an approved backup guide is published.

Help and feedback

A public feedback channel is currently unavailable.
